subject: Career
title: Bridge Ties Across Industries
description: A quick, practical guide to Bridge Ties Across Industries.

hook.text: A healthcare exec befriends a game designer. Two years later, they co-create a health gamification startup.

buildup.text: Cross-industry ties bring novel information — ideas that are obvious in one field but revolutionary in another.

discovery.text: Frans Johansson calls this the 'Medici Effect' — innovation happens at the intersection of diverse fields.

twist.text: Most people only network within their industry. Cross-pollination is rare, which makes it more valuable.

climax.text: Attend one event per quarter outside your field. The unfamiliar is where new ideas live.

punchline.text: Your best idea might come from the person most unlike you.

quiz.question: What is the Medici Effect?
options: Innovation happening at the intersection of diverse fields

details.summary: Bridge ties connect people across different industries, bringing cross-pollination of ideas, practices, and opportunities. These connections are rare because most people network within their own field, making those who bridge industries especially valuable.
details.whyItMatters: Innovation increasingly happens at the intersection of disciplines. Professionals with cross-industry ties access a wider range of career opportunities.
takeaways: Cross-industry ties are rarer and therefore more strategically valuable
Attend events outside your industry to deliberately build bridge ties
Bridge ties provide insight into emerging trends before they cross over

faq.question: How do you find meaningful networking opportunities outside your own industry?
faq.answer: Attend general business conferences, join interdisciplinary professional groups, and participate in online communities organized around skills or interests rather than industries. Alumni networks are especially effective because they span multiple fields naturally.

faq.question: What value can you offer to someone in a completely different industry?
faq.answer: Fresh perspective is the primary value. Solutions that are common knowledge in your industry may be groundbreaking innovations in another. Sharing how your field handles similar challenges creates immediate practical value for cross-industry contacts.
